title: Quiz 1 — Physics in Real Life & Motion

questions.text: Which area of daily life is MOST improved by understanding motion and forces?

_tag.rationale: matches 'physics in real life' + life-area framing

questions.text: Which of the following BEST describes translational motion?
options: An object moves from one point to another without rotating
An object spins around a fixed axis
questions.correct: An object moves from one point to another without rotating

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of PURELY rotational motion?
options: A spinning top on a table
questions.correct: A spinning top on a table

questions.text: Which quantity is measured in rad/s?
In the equation v = r × ω, what does 'r' represent?
options: The radius (distance from the axis of rotation)
The total mass of the object
questions.correct: The radius (distance from the axis of rotation)

_tag.rationale: v = r × ω is core W2-C1 formula

questions.text: A wheel of radius 0.5 m rotates with angular velocity 4 rad/s. What is the linear velocity of a point on the rim?

_tag.rationale: numeric application of v = r × ω

questions.text: Why does the tip of a windmill blade move faster than the base?
options: Because points farther from the axis have greater linear velocity (v = r × ω)
Because the tip has less friction
questions.correct: Because points farther from the axis have greater linear velocity (v = r × ω)

_tag.rationale: conceptual application of v = r × ω

questions.text: Which physical quantity determines the pitch of a sound?

_tag.rationale: sound is W6; outside declared W1-W2 scope of quiz1

questions.text: A ball rolling down a ramp without slipping demonstrates which combination of motion types?
Which of the following is NOT a way physics improves daily life?
Which of the following best represents a lever in action?
options: A ramp loading boxes onto a truck
A flag being raised on a flagpole

_tag.rationale: simple machines = W3-C1; outside W1-W2 scope

questions.text: What type of quantity is angular displacement measured in?
In one complete rotation, the angular displacement of the object is:
Which of the following correctly pairs a linear and its angular counterpart?
A wheel of radius 0.4 m rotates with angular velocity 5 rad/s. What is the linear velocity at the rim?
Which observation BEST shows physics improving safety in daily life?
options: A car's airbag reducing impact force during a crash
A television's screen brightening a room
A fan's blades rotating to move air
questions.correct: A car's airbag reducing impact force during a crash

_tag.rationale: physics improving safety = W1-C1; distractors balanced (Phase 6)

questions.text: What does the equation d = r × θ relate?
Which of the following is the BEST example of physics in navigation?
options: GPS satellites using radio waves to find locations
questions.correct: GPS satellites using radio waves to find locations

questions.text: You feel pushed forward when a jeepney suddenly brakes. Which physics principle explains this?
Why does a longer wrench loosen a tight bolt more easily than a shorter one?
options: It increases torque by increasing the lever arm distance
questions.correct: It increases torque by increasing the lever arm distance

_tag.rationale: torque + lever arm = W3-C1 machine efficiency
